findings.highlight: he came out and quickly retreated to the back
findings.evidenceJa: 女性の姿を見るなり
findings.governingReading: the instant he saw the weakened woman
findings.explanation: The English inserts Kotomine emerging and characterizes his movement as retreat.

findings.highlight: the unconscious woman
findings.evidenceJa: 衰弱した女性
findings.governingReading: the weakened woman
findings.explanation: The victim’s stated condition is changed from severe weakness to unconsciousness.

findings.highlight: his room was the only place he would be able to treat her
findings.evidenceJa: 治療室に使えそうな部屋は言峰の私室ぐらい
findings.governingReading: Kotomine’s private room was about the only room suitable for use as a treatment room
findings.explanation: Room suitability becomes Kotomine’s medical ability being location-dependent.

findings.highlight: I sit down
findings.evidenceJa: 並べられた椅子に座る
findings.governingReading: I sit in one of the chairs arranged in rows
findings.explanation: The chapel’s physical setting is omitted.

findings.highlight: Now, it’s up to Kotomine
findings.evidenceJa: あの女の人が助かるかどうかは言峰次第
findings.governingReading: whether that woman survives now depends on Kotomine
findings.explanation: The woman’s survival stakes are left implicit.

findings.highlight: Shinji became a Master and obtained a Servant
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントを従えていた慎二
findings.governingReading: Shinji, who as a Master had a Servant under his command
findings.explanation: Command authority is changed to acquisition.

findings.highlight: the only ones who become Masters are those who cling to the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: “聖杯”なんてものに縋るしかない人間
findings.governingReading: people with no recourse but to cling to something like the Holy Grail become Masters
findings.explanation: The desperation and absence of alternatives behind Mastership are omitted.

findings.highlight: They can only be saved by the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯でなければ救われないモノ、聖杯でなければ癒されないモノ
findings.governingReading: there are things that cannot be saved, and wounds or things that cannot be healed, except by the Grail
findings.explanation: Two parallel needs, salvation and healing, collapse into one plural rescue claim.

findings.highlight: that must mean the treatment was successful
findings.evidenceJa: 治療は上手くいったという事だろうか
findings.governingReading: does that mean the treatment went well?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s hopeful question is promoted to certainty.

findings.highlight: She survived
findings.evidenceJa: 持ち直しはした
findings.governingReading: she has stabilized or rallied
findings.explanation: Temporary stabilization is overstated as survival.

findings.highlight: If you were an hour later
findings.evidenceJa: 半時ほど遅ければ
findings.governingReading: had you brought her roughly half an hour later
findings.explanation: The remaining rescue window is doubled.

findings.highlight: I would’ve had to see her as a priest
findings.evidenceJa: 本職に戻らねばならなかった
findings.governingReading: I would have had to return to my proper profession
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s dark euphemism about last rites or death is rendered incoherently.

findings.highlight: you are the cause of most of them
findings.evidenceJa: それを増やしたのは他ならぬアンタ
findings.governingReading: you are the very one who increased their number
findings.explanation: Kotomine adding to Shirou’s many troubles becomes causing most of them.

findings.highlight: It’s not that I’m letting him get to me
findings.evidenceJa: その雰囲気に負けた訳じゃない
findings.governingReading: it is not as though I yielded to that atmosphere
findings.explanation: The comic denial of being defeated by Kotomine’s regretful air becomes malformed psychological phrasing.

findings.highlight: I just have to say it
findings.evidenceJa: 泣き言を呟いていた
findings.governingReading: I found myself muttering that weak complaint
findings.explanation: Shirou’s self-conscious recognition that he is whining disappears.

findings.highlight: He just nods
findings.evidenceJa: ただ一言、そうか、と頷いただけ
findings.governingReading: he merely said “I see” and nodded
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s single restrained verbal acknowledgment is omitted.

findings.highlight: So of course you defeated the Master
findings.evidenceJa: 当然倒したのだろうな
findings.governingReading: of course you defeated him
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s question about Shinji becomes an impersonal question about “the Master.”

findings.highlight: accept our own actions
findings.evidenceJa: 自身の行いを是とする
findings.governingReading: affirm our own actions as right
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s severe ethic of self-justification becomes emotional acceptance.

findings.highlight: let it show in your future actions
findings.evidenceJa: これからの自身の行いに問うがいい
findings.governingReading: put that guilt to the question through your conduct from now on
findings.explanation: An injunction to test guilt through future conduct becomes displaying it.

findings.highlight: His words are plausible
findings.evidenceJa: 神父の言葉はもっともだ
findings.governingReading: the priest’s words are reasonable or sound
findings.explanation: Shirou’s agreement is weakened into mere plausibility.

findings.highlight: I deserve some compensation for being asked to treat a woman
findings.evidenceJa: 治療代として話に付き合え
findings.governingReading: as the treatment fee, keep me company for this conversation
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s specific comic fee is replaced by an unspecified entitlement to compensation.

findings.highlight: the priest is right behind me
findings.evidenceJa: 俺のすぐ目の前に立っていた
findings.governingReading: the priest was standing directly in front of me
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s position is reversed.

findings.highlight: There is no crime in participating
findings.evidenceJa: 参加する事、殺しあう事に罪悪などない
findings.governingReading: there is no guilt in participating or killing one another
findings.explanation: Mutual killing is omitted and moral guilt is changed to legal crime.

findings.highlight: some of them die before they reach their goals
findings.evidenceJa: その全てが、目的に届かず終わる
findings.governingReading: all of them come to an end without reaching the goal
findings.explanation: A universal philosophical claim about failed attainment becomes a contingent claim that some people die early.

findings.highlight: This is what people call life
findings.evidenceJa: 積み重ねる徒労を、我々は人生と呼ぶ
findings.governingReading: we call that accumulated futile labor life
findings.explanation: The defining futility and accumulation disappear.

findings.highlight: removes the need for that effort
findings.evidenceJa: その徒労を無くす
findings.governingReading: merely removes that futile labor
findings.explanation: The Grail no longer bypasses futility; it eliminates the need to exert effort at all.

findings.highlight: It is merely a simplification of life
findings.evidenceJa: 人間の生き方をより純化にしたものが聖杯戦争という殺し合い
findings.governingReading: the killing contest called the Holy Grail War is human life reduced to a purer, simpler form
findings.explanation: Both the murder and the claim that the war purifies the structure of human life are omitted.

findings.highlight: Do as you please throughout this war and win
findings.evidenceJa: 気負うことなく勝ち抜くがいい
findings.governingReading: fight through to victory without overstraining or posturing
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s advice about psychological burden becomes license to do whatever Shirou pleases.

findings.highlight: I just need to trample over the wishes of others
findings.evidenceJa: ただ己が心のまま、他者の願いを蹂躙しろ
findings.governingReading: simply follow your own heart and trample the wishes of others
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s imperative is changed into Shirou’s apparent first-person conclusion.

findings.highlight: an incomplete Master like me
findings.evidenceJa: マスターとして中途半端な俺
findings.governingReading: me, halfhearted and unresolved as a Master
findings.explanation: Shirou’s divided commitment becomes a claim that he is incomplete.

findings.highlight: our talk earlier was not helpful
findings.evidenceJa: しなくともよい話をした
findings.governingReading: I spoke of things that did not need to be said
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s admission of unnecessary complication becomes a claim that his talk lacked utility.

findings.highlight: he makes a lousy priest to start with
findings.evidenceJa: 初めっから神父失格
findings.governingReading: he was disqualified as a priest from the beginning
findings.explanation: Rin’s imagined categorical condemnation is softened.

findings.highlight: Don’t worry about that
findings.evidenceJa: 余計なお世話だ
findings.governingReading: that is none of your business or unwanted meddling
findings.explanation: Shirou’s rebuff is mistranslated as reassurance.

findings.highlight: I leave the church for sure this time
findings.evidenceJa: カンカンと乱暴に足音をたてて
findings.governingReading: I leave the chapel at last, my footsteps clattering harshly
findings.explanation: Shirou’s loud, irritated exit staging is omitted.

findings.highlight: answer her with the best honesty I have
findings.evidenceJa: 素直な心で返さなくてはならない
findings.governingReading: respond to that feeling with an open and honest heart
findings.explanation: The natural reciprocal emotional response becomes strained English about degrees of honesty.

findings.highlight: I only abided by your decision
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方の方針に従っただけ
findings.governingReading: I merely followed your policy or course
findings.explanation: Saber’s adherence to Shirou’s standing approach becomes compliance with one decision.

findings.highlight: very gentle
findings.evidenceJa: びっくりするほど優しかった
findings.governingReading: so gentle it startled me
findings.explanation: The unexpected force of Saber’s tenderness is omitted.

findings.highlight: She definitely would’ve died
findings.evidenceJa: 確実に衰弱死していた
findings.governingReading: the woman would certainly have died of debilitation
findings.explanation: The causal bodily mechanism of the victim’s death is omitted.

findings.highlight: You looked like you might not go along with the plan
findings.evidenceJa: 状況次第で方針は変えるって顔
findings.governingReading: a look saying the policy would change if circumstances required
findings.explanation: Saber’s conditional tactical judgment becomes possible disobedience.

findings.highlight: How can you doubt me
findings.evidenceJa: それをそうかぁ？などとよく言えたものですね
findings.governingReading: how dare you answer that with “Really?”
findings.explanation: Saber’s offense at Shirou’s teasing wording becomes concern that he doubts her.

findings.highlight: Let’s end this war for now
findings.evidenceJa: この戦いを終わらせよう
findings.governingReading: let us bring this war to an end
findings.explanation: The English makes the goal temporary.

findings.highlight: an amateur like me
findings.evidenceJa: そんな半端な自分
findings.governingReading: someone as halfhearted or unresolved as I was
findings.explanation: Shirou’s divided purpose becomes lack of skill.

findings.highlight: a battle you chose to start yourself
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の意思での戦いを経験した
findings.governingReading: experienced battle by your own will
findings.explanation: Choosing to participate is narrowed to initiating the battle.

findings.highlight: I want to protect others, like a superhero
findings.evidenceJa: 誰かを守る事、正義の味方になるコトが俺の目標
findings.governingReading: my goal was to protect someone and become an ally of justice
findings.explanation: Two linked aims and the work’s central term are collapsed into a superhero comparison.

findings.highlight: fight against the wishes of others, even if they are five hundred or a thousand years old
findings.evidenceJa: 相手が五百年だろうが一千年だろうが、向こうに回して戦わなくちゃいけないと思うんだ
findings.governingReading: fight those people even if what stands against me is five hundred or a thousand years of pursuit
findings.explanation: Shirou resolves to oppose the claimants; the English makes him fight abstract wishes.

findings.highlight: That is understandable
findings.evidenceJa: 筋が通っている
findings.governingReading: that reasoning is coherent
findings.explanation: Saber’s judgment of internal logic becomes emotional comprehensibility.

findings.highlight: Her direct smile is embarrassing
findings.evidenceJa: まっすぐな微笑がくすぐったくて
findings.governingReading: her open, straightforward smile leaves me pleasantly awkward
findings.explanation: Saber’s sincerity produces a ticklish emotional response, not straightforward embarrassment.

findings.highlight: The winter’s chill makes the starry sky more beautiful
findings.evidenceJa: 冬の星空は冷たく張り詰めて、だからこそ綺麗
findings.governingReading: the winter starscape is cold and taut, and beautiful precisely for that reason
findings.explanation: The sky’s own tense clarity is replaced by ambient temperature improving its beauty.

findings.highlight: I look up at the night sky
findings.evidenceJa: 決して、裏切ることはない
findings.governingReading: I will never betray it or you
findings.explanation: An active standalone repetition of Saber’s vow is wholly absent from the English page.

findings.highlight: a world apart from tonight’s events
findings.evidenceJa: 地上とはかけ離れた場所
findings.governingReading: a place far removed from the earth and severed from tonight’s events
findings.explanation: The night sky’s distance from the terrestrial world is omitted.

findings.highlight: Then I’ll believe in myself
findings.evidenceJa: こっちも精一杯胸を張ろう
findings.governingReading: then I too will hold my head or chest high with all I have
findings.explanation: Shirou’s resolve to carry himself proudly in response to Saber becomes generic self-belief.

findings.highlight: So that I can always be worthy of her trust
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女が信じてくれた自分を最後まで張り通せるよう
findings.governingReading: so that to the end I can remain the self she chose to believe in
findings.explanation: Preserving an identity Saber already trusts becomes continually earning worthiness.
